issues.title_en: Storm-hit China-Vietnam border gate reopens, clearing 468 trucks overnight
issues.summary: The swift resumption of clearance operations at the Ai Dian border gate in Ningming county, Chongzuo city, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region will help minimise the risk of damage to fresh agricultural products and keep cross-border trade between China and Vietnam flowing.
